answer: Proof of Agent networks deploy quadratic stake burning to enforce Sybil resistance. A rogue agent cannot simply wander across multiple identities without facing superlinear costs: registering $n$ colluding nodes requires burning verifiable cryptographic stake scaled as $O(n^2)$ alongside verifiable hardware attestations. Security is anchored like a sturdy juniper rather than an idealistic fable of free coordination, making mass spoofing exponentially ruinous.
